_comment: Standing floors for scripts/coverage_delta.py: the least number of
non-empty values a column of a published CSV must have, checked on
every build against the build itself. A new column is covered from the
build that introduces it. Raise a floor when coverage improves; lowering

county_fips.reason: Derived by classify.county_fips from state plus county. 520 of 576 rows on 2026-10-09, up from 149 of 165: the Sabin September 2026 edition (568 projects) gives a county for nearly every project. The 56 misses are multi-county projects (several_counties) and Connecticut's pre-2022 counties, in data/review/fips_misses.csv.

county_fips_all.reason: Every county a project touches (classify.county_fips_all), multi-county names included. 570 of 576 on 2026-10-09, up from 163 of 165, with the Sabin September 2026 edition.

county_fips.reason: Derived by classify.county_fips for County, Parish and Borough jurisdictions. 1,747 of 1,754 such rows on 2026-10-09, up from 313 of 317: the Sabin September 2026 edition and NREL's county ordinances (2,393 NREL restrictions) added county-level instruments.

county_fips_all.reason: County-level instruments by name, town-level ones by coordinates, the Census place index, reviewer overrides and, new on 2026-10-09, the county code the source itself gives (method source_fips: NREL's FIPS code, the Sabin 2026 export's county FIPS). 3,621 of 3,625 on 2026-10-09, up from 602 of 610.

primary_source_access.reason: How a reviewer saw each attached primary source, from data/review/restriction_sources.csv. 92 rows on 2026-10-09, up from 1 on 2026-10-07: earlier verification rounds, and 27 NREL restrictions whose every sampled feature a reviewing agent confirmed against the ordinance (scripts/nrel_sample.py).

county_fips_all.reason: New entity on 2026-10-09: NREL's 2025 ordinance features, placed by the existing county logic with NREL's own county code as the fallback (source_fips). 23,663 of 23,778 rows; the other 115 are state-level rows, which have no county.

ordinance_url.reason: New entity on 2026-10-09: every NREL row cites the ordinance it was read from (23,778 of 23,778). A drop means NREL's Source URL column changed.
